description.en:
IRON is XPENG's humanoid robotics platform, developed as part of its physical-AI program. The company introduced an initial generation in 2024 and a substantially revised version at its November 2025 AI Day, combining a humanlike body with learned motion and interaction.

The 2025 presentation emphasizes a humanoid spine, flexible outer covering, compact hand mechanisms and coordinated whole-body movement. XPENG describes 82 degrees of freedom for that generation and identifies changes to computing and energy architecture. Those details belong to the announced next-generation design; they should not automatically be applied to every earlier IRON prototype or interpreted as proof of completed production deployment.

specs.label: AI computing throughput
specs.conditions: Combined stated effective compute from three Turing AI chips, Next-Gen IRON announced November 2025.

specs.conditions: Manufacturer describes the November 2025 Next-Gen IRON demonstration, not autonomous industrial deployment.

specs.conditions: Per hand, Next-Gen IRON announced November 2025; not body total.

sources.quote: the hand has 22 degrees of freedom

specs.label: Total degrees of freedom
specs.conditions: Next-Gen IRON unveiled at XPENG AI Day on 2025-11-05; not first-generation 2024 IRON.
